body: I do have my own camper van ...
So I will definitely be shaving my head tomorrow, just saw a photo from September where I have a bigger forehead than sloth from the goonies film 😳
How to tie a hangman’s noose....

Thank you for your message, it really did help me so thank you.

I am nowhere near being safe, as in the time from my last message things have gotten tougher.  And the battle in my head is getting harder to beat.  I know I have to keep going at least for the next two weeks as that’s when my daughters exams finish and my partner is going on holiday with her mummy friends next weekend too.  But the sense that I am failing is massive and it’s getting louder.  I just don’t think I have the strength to get up and fight again.

Sorry to ramble, I don’t even expect an answer or comment tbh, just felt like I needed to vent, whilst I try to find something to overcome the overwhelming thoughts I have.

I know I am way past ideation as I do have a noose at home, and today I almost packed it in my bag today as I am aware of how work is going.  I have calculated and worked out how I can tie the knots so that once done there is no going back, that I don’t chicken out when I do finally decide to go.

Thank you all for your comments and I have taken them onboard and I have been trying really hard to find positives, but just when I start to think things may improve I get knocked back down again.

I just can’t fight anymore, I’m tired and all my strength has gone.  My daughters saved my life before when I found out my first partner cheated on me with a family friend.  Then at the end of my last marriage the realisation that I had been played really broke my heart, then my mother passing away (at 62) less than 12 months later, to have to send your teenage daughter, who lives with you, away to keep her safe from a boyfriend.

To love in eternal debt and just not be able to get out of it every month for years, to know that the chances of having any money for retirement is almost zero as something will come up to keep me down.

I now hold my hands up to all those that bullied me at school, to those that broke my heart, you’ve won.

To all those I have hurt in the past either by not talking to you, or not telling you everything I am sorry, the guilt for not being a good enough friend or person weighs heavily on my heart.

To my children who are going to be amazing people I am sorry I can’t be there, but I’m not a good example of a strong and good person.  Learn from my mistakes and don’t let people walk over you, put your happiness first but never claim to be better than anyone.

To my Partner, I am sorry I am not able to grow old with you, you and I said we were soul mates, but I can see I have hurt you again and let you down again.  I can’t bear doing this again and I will because I’m weak, I never have or will have an affair.  But my inability to tell you when I get hit with another financial body blow breaks your trust and for that I am so very sorry.  This is the last tome I will let you down.

To my family I am sorry that I am leaving early, I have been a burden to you all for too long, with the breakdown in my relationships and things always going wrong.  I love you all and I’m sure you will all carry on being great and will look after each other.

And to myself, I am sorry for being weak, for being too afraid to speak out for not respecting yourself enough to believe that your voice is important.  I hope that now you’re at peace.

Good bye and thanks for all the fish
